I can't check that for you. I don't have access to customer accounts, payment records, or invoices, so I can't see whether a payment went through or when your last charge happened.

Here's where you can find it yourself:

- **Invoices and payment history:** In Lumen, go to Settings > Billing. Your invoices are listed there.
- **Questions about a charge:** If you see a charge you don't recognize, or think you were charged twice, email billing@lumen.io. The billing team can look at your account.

When you email them, include:
- The email address on your Lumen account (dana@corp.com, if that's the one)
- The date of the payment
- The amount
- The last four digits of the card used, if you know them
